svg.title: Sheet set — key screens
svg.desc: Nine thumbnails drawn as sheets of the drawing set: saved plans, New Plan with an import error, plan overview, parts, locations, pick groups, best locations, before/after table and the black-and-white move list print view.
svg.text: Key screens of a plan, in flow order. Each thumbnail is one sheet; the app shell (sheet index, top bar) is left out.
Plans are shared and saved automatically. Opening one
restores it exactly as it was left.
"2026-13-02" is not a valid date. Fix the file and upload it again.
Nothing is saved until all three files pass.
Import error names file, row, column
Settings: period 12 months · fast 24+ · medium 6–23 · slow 1–5 · pick group 5+ jobs
Search, manual move, keep in place
Occupied or empty, always in words
214 groups · 5 or more shared jobs · 99 in one aisle
Different aisles (A · F) are what rule 3 acts on. Each part is the other's partner.
Only marks make a location best,
Aisles D, F, G, I hidden: no change. Changed values in red.
